div.head: Leis Wl 2.3
div.ab: E cil francs hom ki ad e sache e soche e toll e tem e infangentheof, se il est enplaidé e il seit mis en forfeit el cunté, afert a l'os le vescunte en Denelahe XL ores, et de cel hume ki ceste franchise nen ad XXXII ores.

And if an accusation is brought against a baron who possesses rights of jurisdiction, toll, vouching to warranty and the exercise of summary justice upon a thief caught in the act, and he has to pay a fine in the county court, 40 ores in the Danelaw shall fall to the sheriff; and 32 ores in the case of a man who does not possess these privileges.
